target_customer: Banks, commercial lenders and fintechs doing commercial credit underwriting
problem: Commercial underwriting needs manual document intake, financial statement and tax spreading, cash flow modeling and credit memos, which is slow.
business_model: B2B SaaS with human-in-the-loop AI agents (pricing not found)

founders.name: Pranjal Daga
founders.background_notes: Led AI product in Risk at Brex; left an AI/ML PhD at Purdue to help set up Cisco Innovation Labs.

founders.name: Yutong Pei
founders.background_notes: Engineering manager on Brex fraud risk.

founders.name: Joseph Zhou
founders.background_notes: Previously CFO of a mobile gaming startup with 50M USD ARR per YC page.

competitors.name: Blooma
competitors.what: AI platform for commercial real estate loan origination

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing tax returns and financial statements and modeling cash flow needs accuracy in a regulated setting; LLMs in 2023 made extraction feasible.

defensibility.rationale: Integration into lender workflows adds stickiness; other AI underwriting startups emerged 2023 to 2025 (EnFi, CarbonAI, Casca) with similar claims.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or incumbent copy found as of the search; not established.

market_need_then: Axios (2024-07) reported early customers including Slope, Pleo, Rho and Pliant; at founding, demand evidence is the founders' Brex/risk experience only.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand evidence found; March 2025 launch of an AI Credit Analyst was covered but not as a brand story.

outcome_analysis: Accend (S23) raised a 3.2M seed in July 2024 led by Adverb Ventures with YC, General Catalyst and 645 Ventures, grew to an 18-person team per YC and launched an AI Credit Analyst in March 2025. Founders come from Brex risk teams, but no later round, revenue or exit was verified, so its position versus other AI underwriting startups is unclear.
notes: Seed cross-checked via YC page, FinSMEs and Axios (via search summary); an 800K USD YC amount on SeedTable is an estimate and not recorded. One aggregator says batch W23; YC-related sources say S23. Later rounds not searched so coverage partial. Competitor traction not retrieved. Web Archive skipped; withaccend.com not fetched.
